jobs.title: Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
*Gebouwen produceren de hele dag data. Jij zorgt dat daar iets slims mee gebeurt: jouw code maakt er inzichten van waar eigenaren van commercieel vastgoed hun beslissingen op baseren.*

*Bij Healthy Workers bouw je aan ons platform dat met AI en machine learning het energieverbruik van elk gebouw in kaart brengt, en dat vertaalt naar heldere aandachtspunten. Je werkt in een klein team waar jouw features er vanaf dag één toe doen.*

**Over Healthy Workers**


Healthy Workers is AI\-SaaS\-marktleider binnen gebouwoptimalisatie voor commercieel vastgoed. Eigenaren van commercieel vastgoed staan onder flinke druk om hun gebouwen te verduurzamen. Ons platform helpt ze daarbij: we verbinden de installaties en data van een gebouw en laten het slimmer draaien, met minder energieverbruik en meer comfort tot gevolg. We zitten direct aan tafel met die eigenaren. Na Nederland rollen we nu uit in België, Luxemburg en Duitsland, en daarna volgt de rest van Europa.


We zijn een scale\-up: informeel, korte lijnen, en direct contact met onze founders Jonatan en Guus.

**Wat ga je doen?**


Je komt in team Product en je bouwt features van begin tot eind: van een idee tot draaiend in productie.

* Je bouwt API's, datamodellen en integraties in Kotlin met Spring Boot
* Je bouwt mee aan AI\-features die gebouwinstallaties slimmer aansturen
* Samen met ons Data\-team koppel je nieuwe databronnen aan het platform, zodat Healthy Workers dé plek is voor alle gebouw\- en klantdata
* Je lost bugs op en houdt de productie gezond
* Je reviewt code van anderen en krijgt zelf ook reviews, altijd binnen één werkdag
* Je leert ons domein kennen, inclusief SkySpark, ons platform voor gebouwanalyse


Zo ziet je week er ongeveer uit:

* \~60% bouwen: API's, datamodellen, integraties en AI\-features
* \~20% productie: bugs, monitoring, CI/CD en infrastructuur
* \~10% code reviews en security (pentests en ISO)
* \~10% stand\-ups, refinement, sprintplanning en retro

**Onze stack**


Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Terraform, Google Cloud Platform en SkySpark. We plannen in Linear.

**Kom je uit Java**? Perfect! Kotlin voelt al snel vertrouwd, en de rest leer je hier van collega's die het dagelijks schrijven.

**Wat neem je mee?**


Must\-haves:

* Een paar jaar ervaring als back\-end developer met Java of Kotlin en Spring Boot
* Je kunt goed overweg met SQL (bij voorkeur PostgreSQL) en je hebt REST API's gebouwd die in productie draaien
* Je hebt met Docker en CI/CD gewerkt. Kubernetes ken je al of leer je hier
* Je bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in nieuwe technologie
* Je legt technische keuzes helder uit aan collega's van Product, Data en Technical Customer Success
* Je spreekt vloeiend Engels.

Mooi meegenomen:

* Ervaring met Terraform, GitLab CI of Google Cloud Platform
* Kennis van C\#
* Ervaring in een klein productteam bij een scale\-up
* Affiniteit met gebouw\-, energie\- of sensordata

**Wat krijg je terug?**

* Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring. Dat bespreken we open in het eerste gesprek
* Een SAR\-regeling, zodat je meedeelt in de groei van Healthy Workers
* 30 vakantiedagen
* Een opleidings\- en conferentiebudget (KotlinConf telt ook)
* Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon\-werkverkeer
* Een fulltime contract
* Geen piketdienst
* Een direct lijntje naar onze Founders Jonatan en Guus

**Het proces**


Van eerste gesprek tot beslissing duurt het maximaal 2 weken. Na elk gesprek hoor je de volgende dag van ons, zonder weken stilte.

**Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap?**


Solliciteer via onderstaande button of stuur me een berichtje. Je cv of gewoon je LinkedIn\-profiel is genoeg, een motivatiebrief is niet nodig. Wil je eerst sparren of dit iets voor je is? Neem gerust contact op, dan hebben we het erover: Maarten Wolters maarten@healthyworkers.com of \+31 6 13392042\.

jobs.title: Installatie- en Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Bedrijfsomschrijving**  

Een duurzame, winstgevende en aangename toekomst voor een melkveehouder door robotisering, engineering en boerenkennis te combineren, daar geloven we in.


Dat begon ruim 75 jaar geleden met een droom van twee broers in Maassluis. Sindsdien zijn we innovatieve koploper in geautomatiseerde systemen voor melkveehouders over de hele wereld. Met 2,500 gespecialiseerde professionals werken we constant aan nieuwe agrarische revoluties. Dat doen we nog steeds vanuit onze Campus in Maassluis, het gebouw met de hoogst haalbare duurzaamheidsprestaties van Nederland, maar ook wereldwijd. Met als doel, melkveehouden voor een volgende generatie (ook) interessant te maken.

 **Vacatureomschrijving**  

Werk jij graag met de nieuwste technologie en krijg je energie van vrijheid en afwisseling in je werk? Bij Lely krijg je de kans om te werken aan de nieuwste generatie robots in de agrarische sector. In deze rol ben je niet alleen monteur, maar ook pionier. Je werkt met innovatieve producten die nog volop in ontwikkeling zijn en waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken.


Als Installatie en Service Engineer zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van onze oplossingen. Je installeert, onderhoudt en verbetert systemen, waarbij je zelfstandig oplossingen bedenkt en toepast. Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene dag installeer je een nieuw systeem, de andere dag los je een technisch vraagstuk op bij een klant in Nederland.


Je voelt je thuis in de techniek en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende vakgebieden, van elektronica tot mechanische oplossingen. Op locatie zorg jij dat alles werkt zoals het bedoeld is. Je werkt op melkveehouderijen, midden in de praktijk. Dat betekent dat je soms letterlijk tussen de koeien staat. Voor jou geen verrassing, maar juist een omgeving waar je energie van krijgt en waar jouw werk direct zichtbaar impact maakt.


Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

* Installeren en in bedrijf stellen van de nieuwste Lely producten bij klanten
* Uitvoeren van onderhoud en servicewerkzaamheden om systemen optimaal te laten draaien
* Signaleren en oplossen van storingen en technische vraagstukken
* Zelfstandig analyseren van situaties en bedenken van passende oplossingen
* Meedenken over verbeteringen van producten en serviceprocessen
* Samenwerken met collega’s en klanten om de beste resultaten te bereiken

  

**Functie\-eisen**  

Je houdt ervan om zelfstandig te werken, maar weet ook wanneer je moet schakelen met collega’s. Je denkt in oplossingen en krijgt energie van techniek die continu in beweging is. Omdat je werkt met innovatieve producten, is jouw nieuwsgierigheid en leergierigheid net zo belangrijk als je technische kennis.


Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

* Een technische achtergrond op MBO niveau 2 of 3 of vergelijkbare werkervaring
* In het bezit van een rijbewijs B
* Bereidheid om te reizen binnen Nederland (en af en toe België).
* Zelfstandigheid en probleemoplossend vermogen
* Affiniteit met techniek en innovatieve systemen

  

**Aanvullende informatie**  

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector. Wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

* Een internationale werkomgeving waar samenwerking, initiatief en diverse perspectieven worden gewaardeerd
* Een cultuur die leren, experimenteren en eigenaarschap van ideeën stimuleert
* Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
* Een fulltime salarisschaal waarin we graag nog ruimte zien om te groeien: 3000 en 4200 euro per maand.
* En bovendien: we vieren graag! Of het nu een jubileum is of het kerstfeest, bij Lely weten we hoe we moeten vieren! Voor een sfeerimpressie kun je deze video bekijken: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=6WA3e0WHbxE
* Regie over je eigen ontwikkeling, met toegang tot een breed aanbod aan cursussen via de Lely Academy
* Dagelijkse toegang tot uitstekende sportfaciliteiten op de Lely Campus: een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, basketbal\- en volleybalvelden, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt deelnemen aan Hyrox\-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training – en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
* En nogmaals: we vieren graag! Voor een sfeerimpressie kun je deze video bekijken: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=6WA3e0WHbxE


Ook zijn we trots dat onze inzet en visie zijn bekroond met het winnen van de Rotterdamse Ondernemersprijs 2025!

**Recruitment \& selectie bureau, consultancy en/of uitzendbureau?**  

We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wilt aandragen voor onze mooie functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die voor Lely vacatures worden aangeboden, zullen worden behandeld als directe sollicitaties.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team!**


We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M\-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event\-driven microservices and help shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at M\-KOPA.

**The Impact**

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e\-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering**: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under\-banked populations


**Global recognition**: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges**: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets


**AI\-native from day one**: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on


**Fully distributed**: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C\# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event\-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes\-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end\-to\-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Predikt**
-----------------


‍


Predikt is a dynamic Swiss\-Belgian deeptech company at the forefront of innovation, developing cutting\-edge AI\-driven technology. We are an AI\-driven cost \& margin intelligence platform built for enterprise procurement and finance teams, providing unmatched visibility into external cost drivers and their impact on margins. We empower organizations to navigate market volatility, proactively manage risks, protect profitability and make confident, data\-driven decisions. As an early\-stage startup, we are fueled by a strong sense of mission and enthusiasm, striving to make cost intelligence accessible to every procurement and finance leader across the globe.


‍


At Predikt, we are defined by our core values and high ambitions. We are a company that champions integrity, innovation and excellence, creating an environment where everyone supports each other and works collaboratively towards common goals. Our customer\-centric approach ensures we deliver exceptional value and service, while fostering a culture of mutual respect, open communication, and continuous improvement.


‍


Join us on this exciting journey as we transform the way procurement and finance teams understand and act on cost and create a future where volatility is no longer a threat, but a challenge every organization is equipped to face with confidence.


Predikt turns market volatility into structured, forward\-looking cost and margin intelligence for procurement, finance and commercial teams at global CPG and Food \& Beverage enterprises. Our product is live with enterprise customers, and we're now building our commercial team.


Our buyers are a few hundred large enterprises. Deals are significant, sales cycles are long, and decisions involve procurement, finance and the C\-suite. That means go\-to\-market here is about precision, not volume: knowing exactly which accounts and people matter, finding the warmest way in, reaching them at the right moment, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Go\-to\-Market Engineer, you build the engine that turns our target account list into pipeline: the data, systems and automation behind it. You'll work side by side with the founders, who lead our enterprise sales today, and with the Marketing Manager and Account Executive we're adding to the team.


This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales and engineering. You won't write product code with our core engineering team, and you're not an SDR chasing call volume. You own the machine that makes our commercial team faster and sharper, and you'll run parts of it yourself while we build it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and maintain our target account data: our priority accounts, their buying committees (procurement, finance, C\-suite) and the signals that tell us when to engage, such as leadership changes, input cost pressure, relevant hiring or tooling renewals.
* Map warm routes into those accounts through our network, investors, partners and existing customers, and make them usable for the team.
* Design and run signal\-based outreach that reaches several people per account with messages that are relevant to what just changed for them, across email, LinkedIn and events.
* Own our CRM and GTM stack: clean data, clear pipeline stages, and workflows the team actually uses.
* Support account\-based campaigns and events together with Marketing: targeting, audiences, follow\-up flows and measuring what works.
* Help us grow inside existing customers by mapping the next business units, categories and use cases where Predikt can add value.
* Build tools and AI workflows that help the team research, qualify and follow up faster, for example account briefs before meetings, a reusable library for RFP answers and first drafts of proposals.
* Bring the data on what actually converts into our positioning, messaging and ideal customer profile, together with the founders, Marketing, Sales and Product.
* Continuously test and improve how we generate and qualify pipeline, and fix what's broken without waiting to be asked.

**What success looks like**


After 90 days:

* Our priority accounts and their buying committees are mapped and live in HubSpot, with warm routes identified.
* A first signal\-based outreach flow is running and booking meetings.


After one year:

* A clean, reliable view of our priority accounts and a CRM the whole team trusts.
* A repeatable engine that consistently books qualified meetings with decision\-makers at our target accounts, with the founders spending far less time on prospecting.
* Clear pipeline reporting: where opportunities come from, how they move, and what we should do more (or less) of.

**Our current stack**

* **HubSpot** as our CRM and single source of truth
* **lemlist** for sequencing and outreach
* **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** for account and people research
* **Notion** for call recording and meeting notes
* **Notion** for documentation, account plans and internal knowledge
* **Claude** and other AI tools for research, drafting and automation


This is where we are today, not a fixed list. If you know a better tool for the job, we're open to it. You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves.

**What you bring**

* Experience in B2B go\-to\-market, growth, RevOps or demand generation, ideally in a start\-up or scale\-up selling software to enterprises.
* A technical, hands\-on streak: you can script, automate, work with APIs and data, and you enjoy building your own tools.
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling such as HubSpot or Salesforce, Clay or similar enrichment platforms, and sequencing tools, plus a curiosity for how AI can make them smarter.
* An analytical mind: comfortable with data and dashboards, and with turning numbers into decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct and the ability to understand enterprise software well enough to speak about it credibly with senior buyers.
* An entrepreneurial, "get it done" mentality: comfortable starting from a blank page, iterating fast and shipping something that works rather than perfecting it in theory.
* Fluent in English. Dutch, French or German is a plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**Pay \& perks**

* A competitive salary and a stock option plan, so you share in the growth you help create.
* Meal vouchers of €8 per working day.
* Eco vouchers worth €250 per year.
* A net allowance of €175 per month for working from home and using your own equipment.


**Getting around**

* Mobility budget or company car via Lizy: you choose what fits your life.
* Bike lease option.
* Our Leuven office is a 2\-minute walk from the train station.


**Health**

* Hospitalisation insurance via Alan.


**Flexibility**

* Hybrid work, split between our Leuven office and home.
* Work from abroad for up to 3 weeks a year.
* Bring your own device: work with the tools you know best.
* A flexible reward plan is planned for 2027, so you can shape part of your package yourself.


**Team \& culture**

* A yearly offsite, sometimes in the Swiss Alps, sometimes closer to home.
* Plenty of moments together throughout the year: drinks, our Christmas dinner and other team activities.
* A culture of radical transparency, where open and honest communication is the norm.
* An early\-stage startup that's growing fast, with room to take on more if you want it.

Whether you're already experienced in cryptography or eager to grow into the field, you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while making a real impact.

Your job

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an agile DevOps team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, resilient, and high-performing solutions. You will contribute throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation and operational support.

You take ownership of your work, actively contribute ideas, share knowledge with your teammates, and continuously improve both the software and the way of working. Together with your colleagues, you will build high-quality, maintainable, and future-proof solutions using modern technologies and platforms, including Microsoft Azure.

You will primarily develop secure backend services and APIs supporting key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) integrations. Working closely with security specialists, platform engineers, and product owners, you will help deliver critical security services that are used throughout the bank.

Working environment

At ABN AMRO, we believe in creating an open and supportive environment where you can learn, experiment, make mistakes, and celebrate successes. We value feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and we are committed to your professional and personal growth. As part of Platforms & Technology, the foundation of ABN AMRO's digital landscape, you'll work on meaningful challenges that help shape the future of secure banking. We encourage you to take ownership, seize opportunities, and make an impact.

Within ABN AMRO, IT Platforms & Technology (P&T) provides the foundational platforms and services that enable the bank to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently. Alongside governance and operational responsibilities, SI&O is home to several DevOps teams that build and operate critical services used across the organization.

The Crypto Services team develops and operates the platforms that enable secure banking across ABN AMRO. Our services include key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) solutions that support critical applications and infrastructure throughout the bank.

As part of the Crypto Services team, you will contribute to the platforms that form the foundation of secure banking. The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

jobs.title: Senior TypeScript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless), FinTech
jobs.description:
**Senior TypeScript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless), FinTech**  



**Location:** London, Manchester, Leeds, Edinburgh or Bristol (flexible hybrid)
  

  

**Rate:** £600 per day. Inside IR35  

  

**Duration:** 6 months

 **About Codurance**


We're a software craftsmanship consultancy. We build software for clients, and we care about doing it properly: clean code, solid testing, sensible architecture, and teams that keep learning. Our engineers work embedded with client teams, so you get variety, real ownership, and the backing of a wider community of craftspeople who'll challenge you and help you grow.

 **The role**


We're looking for a senior contract engineer to work on a financial platform where correctness actually matters. You'll design, build, and run TypeScript and Node.js services on AWS serverless infrastructure. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional team alongside product, operations, and customer\-facing colleagues, and you'll be the person people go to when they're stuck. This is a build\-and\-run environment: if you build it, you own it in production.

 **What you'll do day to day**

* Design, build, and operate services within your domain, from architecture through to delivery
* Take accountability for the SLAs of what you ship, and keep improving it
* Write and maintain useful documentation for your services
* Mentor and guide other engineers
* Explain how the system works to non\-technical colleagues, without making them feel daft for asking
* Judge when "good enough for now" is the right call, and when it isn't
* Work openly with product and operations, and challenge ideas constructively

 **Requirements**  

Core skills:

* Strong commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Hands\-on AWS experience, including serverless (Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, ECS)
* Strong experience with event\-driven architecture
* Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB
* A track record of leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run model
* Experience mentoring other engineers
* Experience with incident management
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services or FinTech

  

Also important:

* Solid experience designing, building, and running high\-quality workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance
* Comfort working with distributed systems and debugging through tracing and observability tooling
* Experience in a strongly, statically typed language
* The ability to turn business and customer problems into efficient, scalable solutions
* Curiosity about how investment and custody products work

  

Nice to have:

* Experience with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related systems
* Terraform, Serverless Framework and GitHub Actions
* Some exposure to C\#

 **How we work**


We care about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. You'll have autonomy, and with it, full accountability. We'd rather you tell us something is wrong than nod along.

 **Benefits** *Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.*
